sentences.text: The material on record discloses that pursuant to the subject lands having been acquired vide preliminary notification dated 19.07.2014 and final notification dated 07.04.2016 issued under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, the 'Act'), the respondents passed an award only in relation to the lands, but did not award any compensation in respect of the houses, buildings and structures said to have been put by the petitioners.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
It is the grievance of the petitioners that despite buildings, houses and structures being in existence in the said land at the time of acquisition, the 5th respondent/SLAO has proceeded to reject the request of the petitioners for compensation in relation to the same on the sole ground that the structures did not find place in the preliminary notification and as such, the petitioners are before this Court by way of present petition.
4. Per contra, learned HCGP submits that there is no merit in the petition and same is liable to be dismissed.
5. A perusal of the impugned endorsements at Annexures-F, F1 to F12 will indicate that the only ground on which the claim for compensation put forth by the petitioners in relation to the buildings,
houses and structures has been rejected by the 5th respondent/SLAO is that the same do not find a place in the preliminary notification.

However, in view of the petitioners' specific assertion that they have produced material to substantiate their contention that buildings, structures and houses were indeed existing at the time of issuance of the preliminary notification coupled with the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioners that if one more opportunity is granted to the petitioners to substantiate their contentions, I deem it just and proper to set aside the impugned endorsements and remit matter back to the 5th respondent for reconsideration afresh in accordance with law.

In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER i. The petition is allowed.
ii.
The impugned endorsements at Annexures-F and F1 to F12 dated 18.03.2016 are set aside.
iii. Matter is remitted back to the 5th respondent  for reconsideration of the claim of the petitioners afresh in accordance with law.

iv. Liberty is reserved in favour of the petitioners to submit additional pleadings,
documents etc., to substantiate their contentions that the structures, buildings and houses etc., were in existence at the time of issuance of preliminary notification.
v. The 5th respondent shall reconsider the claim of the petitioners and proceed further and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.
